title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the importance of fostering beneficial thoughts, words, and actions
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the importance of fostering beneficial thoughts, words, and actions प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                24 JUL 2026 7:50AM by PIB Delhi Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting how continuous practice in thought, word, and action shapes one's character and direction in life. The Prime Minister wrote on X; "कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यदभीक्ष्णं निषेवते। तदेवापहरत्येनं तस्मात् कल्याणमाचरेत्॥" Whatever a person continuously practices through their actions, thoughts, and words ultimately shapes their personality and draws them in that very direction; therefore, one should always give space only to beneficial subjects in one's thoughts and conversations. कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यदभीक्ष्णं निषेवते। तदेवापहरत्येनं तस्मात्कल्याणमाचरेत्॥ pic.twitter.com/0MyI0fXlu2 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) July 24, 2026 *** MJPS/SS/PRK (रिलीज़ आईडी: 2288695) आगंतुक पटल  : 336 इस विज्ञप्ति को इन भाषाओं में पढ़ें: Urdu , हिन्दी , Gujarati , Malayalam Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the importance of fostering beneficial thoughts, words, and actions प्रविष्टि तिथि:

title: Prime Minister urges Sonam Ji to follow doctors' advice and prays for his good health
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister urges Sonam Ji to follow doctors' advice and prays for his good health प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                24 JUL 2026 6:10AM by PIB Delhi Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today urged Sonam Ji to maintain his daily routine according to the advice of doctors and to regain his previous weight as soon as possible. Shri Modi stated that he prays to the Almighty that Sonam Ji remains healthy. In a post on X, the Prime Minister shared: "मैं सोनम जी से आग्रह करता हूँ की वो डॉक्टरों की सलाह के अनुसार अपनी दिनचर्या रखें और जल्द से जल्द अपना पुराना वज़न फिर से प्राप्त करें। मैं प्रभु से प्रार्थना करता हूँ कि सोनम जी स्वस्थ रहें। @Wangchuk66 @GitanjaliAngmo" मैं सोनम जी से आग्रह करता हूँ की वो डॉक्टरों की सलाह के अनुसार अपनी दिनचर्या रखें और जल्द से जल्द अपना पुराना वज़न फिर से प्राप्त करें। मैं प्रभु से प्रार्थना करता हूँ कि सोनम जी स्वस्थ रहें। @Wangchuk66 @GitanjaliAngmo — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) July 23, 2026 ******* MJPS/SS/PRK (रिलीज़ आईडी: 2288692) आगंतुक पटल  : 571 इस विज्ञप्ति को इन भाषाओं में पढ़ें: हिन्दी , Punjabi , Gujarati , Malayalam Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister urges Sonam Ji to follow doctors' advice and prays for his good health प्रविष्टि तिथि:
